findings: Actual five-item taskset command shape is accepted only when CPU/native/profile match frozen preparation and execution.
Acceptance requires complete execution, pinned complete supervisor with same argv, and both owned-cleanup confirmations.

Cache0 versus cache1 treatment, common native hash, accumulation, original profile and input identity bind to one freeze/preparation. Missing metadata cannot authorize a cache-pair pass; artifact_equality is separately reported.
Per-iteration performance sidecars and available counters must agree with treatment; enabled treatment requires measured positive cache hits.
Arithmetic-audit and every probe-history count/status are checked against canonical line-search receipts before timing totals. Prior unsupported-category counterexamples now reject.

Only declared trial child user/system CPU and peak RSS fields are removed from scientific JSON equality. Objective/prior/acceptance/support/rank/floor diagnostic fields remain exact. Required contiguous factors, metadata, row payloads and final undamped/full-rank binary factor are retained.
Strict profile history count/final update and unchanged two consecutive 1e-8 m criterion are checked; empirical floor-limited equality remains progress-only and accepted_covariance is always false.
Missing run paths and unmatched artifacts remain explicit failures. Timing scopes remain partial/nested; missing counters do not become zero measured durations.
remaining_scope_limits: The fixture metadata binding check used explicitly synthetic execution values and did not read or modify actual prepared job outputs.
The tool relies on the separately reviewed/frozen runner for actual input verification and environment provenance; it does not rerun the estimator or certify current remote process liveness.
Real paired GNSS profiles, replay outcomes and full-fit efficacy remain outstanding.
scope: Offline analysis/tool correctness only; no native fit run or numerical-equivalence result is asserted.
